knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(readr)
genus_table <- read_csv("Datasets/genus_table.csv")
groups <- read_csv("Datasets/groups.csv")

#NMDS
ordination <- metaMDS(genus_table, distance = "bray")
ef <- envfit(ordination, genus_table, nperm = 999)

ef

ef.adj <- ef
pvals.adj <- p.adjust(ef$vectors$pvals, method = "fdr")
ef.adj$vectors$pvals <- pvals.adj
ef.adj
p.adjust.methods

site <- as.data.frame(scores(ordination, display = "sites"))
site <- cbind(site, Treatment = groups$Treatment)

spp<- as.data.frame(scores(ef, display = "vectors"))
spp<- cbind(spp, Species = rownames(spp))
spp<- cbind(spp, pval = ef$vectors$pvals)
sig.spp<- subset(spp, pval<= 0.05)

theme_set(theme_bw())
nmds<- ggplot(site, aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color=factor(site$Treatment),
                 shape = factor(site$Treatment)), size = 6) +
  labs(colour= "Treatment", shape = "Treatment")

nmds

B2<- nmds +
  geom_segment(data=sig.spp, aes(x=0, xend=NMDS1, y=0, yend=NMDS2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data= sig.spp, aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2, 
               label= Species))

B2

```
